tha-ap14:1.1: Ekatthambhika.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato mahāpūgagaṇo ahu / saraṇaṅgatā ca te Buddhaṃ saddahanti Tathāgataṃ. // //
tha-ap14:2.1: Sabbe saṅgamma mantetvā māḷaṃ kubbanti satthuno / ekatthambhaṃ alabhantā vicinanti brahāvane. // //
tha-ap14:3.1: Te 'haṃ araññe disvāna upagamma gaṇaṃ tadā / añjalim paggahetvāna paṭipucchiṃ gaṇaṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap14:4.1: Te me puṭṭhā viyākaṃsu sīlavanto upāsakā / mālaṃ mayaṃ kattukāmā ekatthambho na labbhati. // //
tha-ap14:5.1: Ekatthambhaṃ mamaṃ detha ahaṃ dassami satthuno / āharissām' ahaṃ thambhaṃ appossukkā bhavantu te. // //
tha-ap14:6.1: Te me thambhaṃ pavecchiṃsu pasannā tuṭṭhamānasā / tato paṭinivattitvā āgamaṃsu sakaṃ gharaṃ. // //
tha-ap14:7.1: Aciraṃ gate pūgagaṇe thambhaṃ adās' ahaṃ tadā / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena paṭhamaṃ ussāpes' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap14:8.1: Tena cittappasādena vimānaṃ upapajj' ahaṃ / ubbiddhaṃ bhavanaṃ mayhaṃ satabhūmisamuggataṃ. // //
tha-ap14:9.1: Vajjamānāsu bherisu parivārem' ahaṃ tadā / pañcapaññāsakappamhi rājā āsiṃ Yasodharo. // //
tha-ap14:10.1: Tatthāpi bhavanaṃ mayhaṃ satabhūmisamuggataṃ / kūṭāgāravarūpetaṃ ekatthambhaṃ manoramaṃ. // //
tha-ap14:11.1: Ekavīsatikappamhi Udeno nāma khattiyo / tatrāpi bhavanaṃ mayhaṃ satabhūmisamuggataṃ. // //
tha-ap14:12.1: Yaṃ yaṃ yon' upapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ / anubhomi sabbam etaṃ ekatthambhass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap14:13.1: Catunavut' ito kappe yaṃ thambham adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ekathambhass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap14:14.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti. // //
tha-ap14:15.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekatthambhiko thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
